why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: On a desktop or laptop, open inverted-lambda.com/platform/beta . On 8 November 2026 this sent us to the homepage and opened a "Connect Wallet" box that said "Approve the connection in MetaMask."
Approve the connection and sign the message. In June the site said: "Signature required to log in. Please sign the message in MetaMask." It also had a "Referral code (optional)" field.

If you're asked for an access code, you need one from the team. The June site said "Enter your access code to continue." We closed the wallet box without connecting, so we don't know whether the beta still asks, and the site hasn't published how to get a code.
Pick a task and drive the arm with your keyboard. A phone can join as a tilt controller ("tilt the phone to aim"): the phone shows a code, and you press Connect phone on the desktop and type it in.
Finish the objective and let the upload complete. Check whether the points are confirmed or pending, and switch tasks when you reach a limit.
costs: Taking part is free. We found no deposit, purchase, mint or stake, and signing in is a signed message, not a paid transaction. The June code put chain ID 8453, which is Base, in that message. The platform registers each run on-chain itself, and we found nothing asking users to pay gas for it. What it costs you is time and a computer that can run a 3D scene in the browser.
risks: Points have no stated value, so you could put in hours and get nothing. Excluded countries, minimum age and VPN rules are unknown, because we couldn't read the terms. The app does warn that some networks are refused: "On mobile data or a restricted Wi-Fi, switching networks usually clears it."
